data.function: re-rank report: V319 and V318 against R8 (owner's answer of 2026-10-03: DC input 12 to 18 V, 12 V supply or 4S LiPo)
data.ruling: The refutation stands, scope function. The figure says "No R8 requirement value changes", and that is false. V171 is a value found for research. Its owner answer is "for research (owner, 2026-09-28)". The last P2 to find it, FU-2H, set the Port current monitor's input withstand to 20 V, "the top of the DC input". FU-2H's datasheet verifier confirmed it against "Scope: 12 to 20 V DC input". V319 replaces 12 to 20 V with 12 to 18 V. That moves the Port current monitor's input withstand requirement from 20 V to 18 V. The figure states that 18 V withstand itself, so it contradicts its own opening sentence. The rest of the figure holds. INA3221 SBOS576C 6.1 rates the IN+ and IN- common mode at -0.3 to 26 V, 8 V above 18 V. The 27 V bus hold of V318 is 1 V above 26 V. The INA228s sit on the ESC pack side. The conclusion therefore stands: lowering the DC input to 18 V keeps every R8 part inside its rating under a single fault. Only the "no requirement value changes" statement is refuted. The change relaxes the requirement, from 20 V to 18 V, and no R8 part fails because of it.
data.evidence: Research.md:884 V171: "What is the highest voltage, in V, a port current monitor must measure and withstand at its inputs?", answer "for research (owner, 2026-09-28)". FU-2H 002-P2-R8.json, V171 found: "Measure to 8.7 V ... withstand 20 V, the top of the DC input (owner, 2026-09-25)". In the same file, Port current monitor requirement "input withstand" = "20 V", source "V171 (found)". FU-2H 011-P4-datasheet-R8.json, "found V171" confirmed, evidence "Scope: 12 to 20 V DC input". Research.md:1032 V319: "A 12 V supply or a 4S LiPo pack ...: 12 to 18 V, in place of 12 to 20 V. The overvoltage cut-off trips above 18 V" (owner, 2026-10-03). Research.md:1031 V318 holds the bus at or under 27 V for the cut-off window. INA3221 6.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings, read from the PDF fetched 2026-10-03T01:35:31Z (HTTP 200, 2,118,543 bytes): analog inputs IN+, IN- common mode -0.3 to 26 V; differential -26 to 26 V; VS 6 V. Revision C (September 2026). The resulting change is: Port current monitor input withstand, 20 V before V319, 18 V under V319.
